name: Media Removal Requests
description: Lets users request removal of media they requested, with approval, and deletes it from Radarr/Sonarr once approved.

permissions.name: Request Media Removal
permissions.description: Ask for media you requested to be removed, deleting its files.

permissions.name: Manage Removal Requests
permissions.description: Approve, decline and withdraw other users' removal requests.

notifications.name: Removal Requested
notifications.description: Sent when a removal request needs approval.

notifications.name: Removal Approved
notifications.description: Sent when a removal request is approved and the media is deleted.

notifications.name: Removal Declined
notifications.description: Sent when a removal request is declined.

notifications.name: Removal Automatically Approved
notifications.description: Sent when a removal request was approved without review.

notifications.name: Removal Failed
notifications.description: Sent when an approved removal could not be carried out.
